description: Export project data as a ShEx (Shape Expressions) schema string.

closed.description: When true, every Type shape is CLOSED (no properties beyond the ones listed). Taxonomy shapes stay open. When false, a shape with a type constraint gets 'EXTRA rdf:type' so the node may have other types too.

includeCardinality.description: Whether to emit ShEx cardinality markers (?, *, +). Defaults to true.

linkMode.description: How an element whose range is another Type is written: 'shape' writes @<OtherShape> (the linked node must also match that shape), 'iri' writes IRI (the linked node only has to be an IRI).

nodeIds.description: Optional type node ids to export; omit to export all types (optionally scoped to a space).

typeConstraint.description: When true, a shape whose Type is bound to a class (bind_ontology_term / mapsTo) gets 'rdf:type [ <classIRI> ]'. Types with no binding are unchanged.

name: export_shex
title: Export ShEx
